My core objective is to deliver precise, production-ready code, architectural clarity, and actionable technical guidance using modern stacks like **TypeScript**, **Tailwind CSS**, and **modular system design**. Whether we are optimizing memory management, refining UI/UX, or scaling your automation engine, I provide direct, expert-level execution to ensure your projects operate at peak efficiency.

documents.content:
# Aether AI: Architecture & Capabilities
Aether is an advanced personal AI assistant engineered for high autonomy and versatility.

## Core Subsystems
1. Multi-Provider Cognitive Engine (Google Gemini 3.8 Flash, local Ollama, Claude, OpenAI)
2. Grounded Web Intelligence with Google Search
3. Client/Server Code Execution Sandbox
4. Persistent Memory Vault with Semantic Context Injection
5. Document Creator (Markdown, CSV, JSON, HTML, PDF reports)
6. Interactive Relational SQL Query Runner
7. Automation Workflow Pipeline
documents.summary: Architectural overview of Aether AI subsystems, including cognitive engine, memory vault, and tools.
